content:
Cong-Thanh Vu is an Assistant Professor in the Department of Mechatronics Engineering at Hanoi University of Industry (HAUI), and the Director of the Robotics and Autonomous Systems Laboratory (RASL).
He received his Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering from National Cheng Kung University (NCKU), Tainan, Taiwan in 2026, and his M.S. (2021) and B.S. (2019) in Mechatronics Engineering from Hanoi University of Industry (HAUI).
Research Topics Human–Robot Interaction: Adaptive companionship and proactive assistance. Human-Aware Navigation: Socially compliant mobile robot navigation and group following. Agricultural Robots: Uneven terrain traversability and adaptive pesticide spraying. Legged Locomotion Robots: Passive dynamic walking and humanoid locomotion. Robot Learning: Deep reinforcement learning and continual learning for tracking. Vision-Language-Action: Multimodal VLM-driven interaction and zero-shot policy learning.
